content:
Seven fresh tracks are now in rotation on La Onda Libre, the free online indie radio station broadcasting from Laredo, Texas.

The new batch brings seven new artists to the station: 1000 Handz with "Early On," A Himitsu with "Adventures," Alexander Nakarada with "Forest Walk," Komiku with "We have to do something," Pamela Yuen with "Every Thought," tubebackr with "FUJI," and zero-project with "The crossroads of change."

La Onda Libre plays independent music around the clock, free for everyone. Listen live at webbwatch956.com.
